system.description:
With patient, pervasive effort you strip away the defenses of even the most determined mind, tearing out personality and free will until nothing remains but a pliant slave.

You must have unrestricted access to the subject over several nights. Each night make a Mental Challenge (retest Intimidation). When you accumulate successes equal to the subject's Self-Control/Instinct Traits (or Willpower Traits for those without vampiric Virtues), their mind is shattered: they follow your orders automatically, with no test or eye contact required to Dominate them, but gain one free retest against any other Cainite's Dominate. A drone cannot create art or teach. If the slave avoids all contact with you for six game sessions (minus one per Willpower Trait spent, minimum one), the Conditioning breaks.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
